pairs.question: Nonne mirandum est lavacro dilui mortem? Quia mirandum est, idcirco non creditur?
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical exchange. Kept the preceding interrogative 'nonne mirandum est lavacro dilui mortem?' as setup so that 'quia mirandum est' has its referent; the operative question is 'quia mirandum est, idcirco non creditur?'. Answer starts at 'atquin eo magis credendum est' (the direct retort) and stops there; the text continues after a colon with 'qualia enim decet esse opera divina nisi super omnem admirationem?', which is elaboration/justification, not the direct answer, so it is cut. Stripped the section marker '[2]' and the framing 'quid ergo?'; normalized capitalization and terminal punctuation.
